title: Home
body: nlcli nlcli turns a natural-language request into a shell command, shows the command, and asks before running it. It is a thin natural-language layer over the command line—not a replacement for your shell. See it in action Download the screencast $ nlcli "show the ten largest files here" du -ah . | sort -hr | head -10 Run? [Enter/e/q/t] What it does Generates one shell command from each request. S…

title: Getting started
body: Getting started Install a release The installer downloads the latest release for the current operating system, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and places nlcli in ~/.local/bin : curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbeers/nlcli/main/install.sh | sh Put the destination on PATH if it is not there already: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" Choose another install directory with NLCLI_INSTALL…

title: Usage
body: Usage Options -n, --dry-run Print the command without running it -y, --yes Run non-risky commands without prompting -e, --explain Include the command explanation --history Show local command history -h, --help Show help -v, --version Show the version The request is the remaining positional text, so these forms are equivalent: nlcli "show the ten largest files here" nlcli show the ten largest files…

title: Configuration
body: Configuration nlcli reads three settings: TOML key Environment override Purpose api_key NLCLI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY Endpoint authentication base_url NLCLI_BASE_URL or OPENAI_BASE_URL OpenAI-compatible API base URL model NLCLI_MODEL or OPENAI_MODEL Model name; defaults to gpt-4o-mini A base URL such as https://api.openai.com/v1 is normalized to the /chat/completions endpoint.
